title: Packers CEO Ed Policy: Players develop best in an environment of continuity, not chaos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers CEO Ed Policy: Players develop best in an environment of continuity, not chaos
sources.description: Back in January, there was an open question as to whether Packers CEO Ed Policy would elect to keep head coach Matt LaFleur after the club finished 9-7-1 in the regular season and fell to the Bears in the wild card round.
